content: yt-dlp fetches source media/audio from YouTube; ffmpeg performs trimming (seek + duration, stream copy when possible) and format conversion. yt-dlp shells out to ffmpeg internally for audio extraction (-x flag). Node.js wrappers exist (ytdlp-nodejs) but the reliable pattern is invoking the yt-dlp CLI/binary as a child process from a background worker, not doing extraction inline in an HTTP request handler, since downloads can take seconds to tens of seconds and depend on an unreliable third party.
